# PhysicsConstraintSpring 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PhysicsConstraintSpring:Void constraint:Int32, frequency:Float32, damping:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `constraint` | In | Int32 | required | A distance or slider constraint. |
| `frequency` | In | Float32 | required | How fast the spring swings, in Hz. About 1 is soft, 10 is stiff. |
| `damping` | In | Float32 | required | 0 swings for a long time, 1 does not swing. |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Makes the stops of a distance or slider constraint soft, like a spring, instead of hard. A frequency of 0 makes them hard again.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
